{{Youmay|the device used to hide a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] signature from [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]|[[Scrambler (droids)|the weapon]] used to scramble [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' circuits}}
A '''scrambler''' was a device that was used to hide a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] signature from another ship's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Relin Druur]] and [[Drev Hassin]]'s [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was equipped with a scrambler and [[Baffler/Legends|baffler]] to help hide the fighter's signature.
